context: Hina reads a picture book with Sho.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: しょう、絵本、本当、面白い、ね。
lines.en: Sho, this picture book is really so much fun.
lines.style: Bright, open excitement on the first word. Genuine childish warmth—not performed. Slightly breathless as she shares her discovery. Inviting him to agree, not demanding it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Yeah—it really is fun to look at.
lines.style: Soft, small agreement. Brief pause after the opening particle. Quiet sincerity—a six-year-old confirming what matters to him. No rush to fill space.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 一緒に、読むの、本当、嬉しい。
lines.en: I'm so happy we're reading it together.
lines.style: Warm, genuine relief underneath the brightness. Slight emphasis on 'together'—it's the part that matters most. Soft landing on the final word, like settling into the moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I really like stories that are kind like this one.
lines.style: Thoughtful, small voice. A six-year-old noticing something true about himself. No self-consciousness. Gentle, unhurried pace. Trailing softly at the end.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: This really is such a good book.
lines.style: Satisfied warmth settling in. Slight emphasis on the certainty—she knows what she likes. Soft, contented landing. A small child at peace with a moment that's working.
